round6_assessment: QA ROUND 6 (2026-11-23): graded in hidden_files/qa_round6/verdicts_bikes_core.md and verdicts_bikes_custom.md. CERTIFIED: the three chassis sheets only (acro solo, mach solo v2, tandem v2 -- 16/16 cells each, all four directions true; the mach front-row tilt and the tandem's missing front/back views from round 4 are FIXED). NOT CERTIFIED: every rider stack, solo and tandem, base and outfit, all six cast members -- ZERO rider frames were sliced or bound this round and the existing flat bike bindings stay exactly as they are. The systemic defect is in the rider BASE sheets: side-row riders are drawn too tall for the 192px cell, so the head top is sliced flat at the cell top and the missing head-top is painted as a detached hair-coloured blob at the bottom of other cells (it would render as a floating blob under the wheels); in front/back rows the hands hang at the hips off the handlebars and the feet dangle beside the wheel off the pedals; row-4 riders sit behind the saddle. Tandem additionally has no real passenger pose (passenger never reaches her pedals/bars; front/back views fuse the two riders into one). Nearest miss, NOT certified: Tasha + mach chassis, Left, base/canon/gothic passes every riding test and fails only on the base sheet's sliced head + loose dome -- one base-sheet fix away. Full report: systems/transportation/bike_qa_report.md (ROUND 6 addendum).
round8_assessment: QA ROUND 8 (2026-11-23): graded in hidden_files/qa_round8/verdicts/wave2_bikes.md (wave-2 delivery, manifest 34/34 exact). ZERO bike frames were sliced or bound this round -- no stack passed -- and the existing flat bike bindings stay exactly as they are. The three chassis stand certified (none were re-delivered). B1-B6 BASES STILL OPEN, all six, on contact failures: row 1 hands never touch the bars (hands hang at the hips while the bars stand untouched at shoulder height) and feet dangle off the pedals; row 2 feet also dangle off the pedals; rows 3-4 the seat sits ahead of the saddle (saddle empty behind) -- on the mach chassis row 3 is marginal (saddle front tip) but row 4 fails. Sliced heads are fixed (every side-row head whole) and direction truth is fixed (true left row 3, true right row 4 on all bases), BUT B3 Custom Female keeps a detached brown hair dome at the bottom of row-2 cells 1 and 3 and B5 Custom Femboy keeps a detached lavender hair dome below the feet in row-2 cells 2 and 4. All bases share a new consistency defect: the row-3 figure is drawn smaller than row-4 (141 px vs 156 px). B7 TANDEM PASSENGER x6 STILL OPEN for all six: side rows 3-4 are a genuine dedicated passenger pose and PASS as poses (rear saddle area, feet at rear crank, hands on rear bar / driver's waist, bodies separate), but front/back rows still fuse the pair into one body (stacked heads, four arms, splayed spare legs, halo hair in back), passenger hands hold nothing, feet dangle, and the passenger is drawn smaller than the driver. B8-B12 OUTFIT LAYERS ARE FIXED and wait only on their bases: B8 Riley lounge (painted skin ~0 px, sleeves fitted), B9 Tasha obsidian (painted skin gone, top below chin, paddles gone; minor new nits: mismatched floating strap heights row 1, wide bowl-like bottom row 2, dangling string ties rows 3-4), B10 Tasha canon rows 1-2 (pendant at chest, collar seated), B11 Tasha gothic row 1 (collar below chin), B12 Custom Futanari canon (neckline below chin row 1; rows 3-4 magenta key-hole filled with garment, ring detail only). NEW DEFECTS in previously passed layers, visible only stacked over the new bases: Female streetwear row 1 hood band over mouth/chin (all 4 cells); Male streetwear row 1 hood ring over mouth/chin (all 4); Futanari streetwear row 1 collar over mouth/chin (all 4); Femboy streetwear row 1 cells 1-2 collar over chin/mouth; Futanari athletic row 1 has NO shoes (bare feet; rows 2-4 shod); Female athletic row 1 collar band touches the chin (minor). All other remaining layers composite cleanly and wait only on their bases. B12 CANONICAL COPY: the wave-2 copy (162,150 B, SHA-256 8f054c2d...) is the graded/canonical file; the wave-1 copy (190,633 B, SHA-256 39c39478...) is discarded and must not be used anywhere.
round8_f1_note: QA ROUND 8 PHASE 3 -- F1 MASTERS (2026-11-23): all 32 flat transportation sheets in the sheets section above were replaced by their pixel-perfect PNG masters (round-8b grading: figures exact, mask XOR 0.000%); sheet keys and every sheet reference in this file now name the .png masters (sheets live in the pack at art/sheets/<repo-relative path> and in the project at the repo-relative path, where they replace the .jpg files). The already-sliced frame PNGs are UNCHANGED (sample-verified at integration: re-keying the masters reproduces the pack frames' figures with 0 RGB differences on mutually opaque pixels). The same binding covers the remaining legacy bike masters, which have no .jpg references in this file: the 3 chassis masters (systems/transportation/layered/bike_chassis_acro_solo_4x4.png, bike_chassis_mach_solo_4x4.png, bike_chassis_tandem_4x4.png -- the round-6 chassis bindings already named .png sources), the 25 layered rider bike sheets (systems/transportation/layered/*_bike_* -- graded stacks, never sliced, references live in the QA reports), and tandem_female_tasha_side2_fix.png (the side-2 redo sheet whose frame is bound as index 4 of tandem_female_tasha_sheet). Full F1 state: systems/cast/cast_sheets.json (f1_masters).

layered_stacks_bench2.note: BENCH-2 BINDING (2026-11-23): the first bound rider bike stacks in the project. Built in sheet space over the certified round-6 v2 chassis (reconstructed pixel-exact from the layered_chassis_round6 frames -- the layered/ mach and tandem SHEETS in the pack are the v1 drawings, not the certified v2, and were NOT used) and sliced as full-cell frames (344x192, anchor (172,191), the cell register bench round 2 graded against). Provenance split, recorded per sheet: rows 1-2 are Neon's v5 (QA round 11 contact PASS, pixel-identical in the bench sheets); rows 3-4 and the tandem DRIVER layers are in-house bench work (Bossy, Riley's Neon-fails rule) drawn at the chassis register -- fist-to-grip gap 0.0 in all 144 side cells, feet on the crank circle, seat on the saddle (BENCH2_REPORT.md). Outfit stacks bind only where the QA-round-9 v3 layer's garment fit over the bench base passes per-cell measurement; held stacks are listed in held_outfit_stacks with reasons. FINDING 1 (bench round 2): the tandem coordinates quoted in the round-11 verdict (front bars x~300-330, rear saddle x81-119, cranks (178,148)/(108,148)) describe the layered tandem sheet in its own crop, not the certified v2 frame register; against the v2 frames at the anchor rule the stations are driver grip x94-121, driver saddle x115-150 top y48, front crank (143,140); passenger saddle x212-260 top y44, stoker grip x169-191, rear crank (188,140). The bench rows are graded and bound at the v2 register. FINDING 2 (bench round 2): in the layered mach SHEET (art/sheets/systems/transportation/layered/bike_chassis_mach_solo_4x4.png) rows 3 AND 4 both face right (R4-R3 diff ~1,381 px, inter-frame noise), while the certified v2 frames have row 4 as the true mirror of row 3. The sheet is left as delivered (recorded, not silently fixed); these stacks use the correct facing from the certified v2 frames / bench sheets. B1-B7 are CLOSED by this binding (see status). OUTFIT OUTCOME (binding measurement + visual check, 2026-11-23): 0 of the 22 QA-round-9 v3 outfit stacks bind. The v3 layers are full-figure layers in the v3 poses; over the bench bases they double the rider in rows 3-4 and seat nowhere (per-cell garment overhang 0.12-0.69, detached far components up to 2,516 px). They stay open as outfit items in held_outfit_stacks; B1-B7 stay closed on the base stacks.

status.note: Solo bases B1-B6 and tandems B7 bind whole: base stacks for all six cast members, solo and tandem (driver + passenger). Outfit stacks bind per-stack on measured garment fit; any held outfit stacks are listed under held_outfit_stacks and stay open as outfit items only -- they do not reopen B1-B7.
